name: letta server
summary: Launch a Letta server process (Typer CLI entrypoint).
purpose: Starts the REST API server that LettaUi proxies to.
whenToUse: Whenever you need a running Letta v0.16.8 backend; not needed if the server already runs in Docker.
howToUse: 1) pip install letta==0.16.8 2) run `letta server` with optional flags.

name: letta (no subcommand)
summary: Running bare `letta` invokes server() via invoke_without_command callback.
purpose: Convenience default so `letta` alone boots the REST server.

name: version()
summary: Prints letta.__version__ (internal helper, not registered as a Typer command in 0.16.8 main app).

name: letta load <connector> (legacy module)
summary: cli_load.py documents `letta load <data-connector-type> --name <dataset-name>`; in 0.16.8 the module is a stub (app = typer.Typer()) NOT registered in main.py — archival loading is done via REST /v1/sources + /v1/folders instead.
purpose: Historical CLI data ingestion into archival memory.
whenToUse: Only on older Letta versions; for 0.16.8 use the Sources/Folders REST flow or the LettaUi Files panel.
howToUse: 1) Do NOT rely on `letta load` in 0.16.8 (unregistered). 2) Use POST /v1/sources then upload files.
example:
# legacy form (pre-0.16.x):
# letta load directory --name mydata --dir ./docs --ext .txt,.md
